description: Apply atomic cell/formula/name/structural edits to an .xlsx file, optionally recalculate formula caches with Formualizer, write output_path, and return the canonical edit + recalculation receipt (set details:true in request for exact cell diff).

output_path.description: Path to write the edited and recalculated .xlsx file.

request.description: StatelessEditRequest object, e.g. { ops: [{ kind: 'set_cells', sheet_name: 'Sheet1', cells: { A1: { kind: 'value', value: 30 } } }], recalculate: 'auto' }.

details.description: Compute exact cell-level diff in receipt (default: false).

ops.description: Write operations (e.g. kind: 'set_cells' with sheet_name, cells map, and overwrite_formulas: true when replacing formulas).

name: edit_xlsx
title: Batch Edit & Recalculate XLSX
